name: Halvorsen Attractor
desc: The cyclically-symmetric Halvorsen strange attractor integrated at 65k steps a frame and splatted into a slowly self-rotating fading density buffer, its spiralling triple-lobed shell of dense filaments glowing violet-to-cyan-to-gold, or recast as iq-cosine plasma, molten ember, glacial ice, or graphite pencil hatching.

density.doc: integration steps per frame (more = denser, brighter shell)

energy.doc: exposure / glow amplitude of the density field
